## Checklist

- [ ] It is an MCP server, client, SDK, or MCP resource (not a general AI tool, prompt pack, or agent skill set).
- [ ] The entry uses the format `- [Name](https://link) - Concise description ending with a period.`
- [ ] It is in the most fitting section, in **alphabetical order**.
- [ ] The description is one sentence with no promotional language.
- [ ] The project is actively maintained (commit or release in the last 12 months) and documented.
- [ ] The link works and the entry isn't already listed.
- [ ] I read the [contributing guidelines](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
